readability.rationale: isCancellable is one named rule shared by the view (button shown) and mirrored by the conditional UPDATE guard; error branches are explicit.

maintainability.rationale: Cancel reuses the Result/conflict pattern and render(); the hidden filter field keeps the user in the same filtered view without session state.

security.rationale: Cancel is a POST behind the cross-site guard; route id is validated as digits and bound as a parameter; filter value goes through findEquipment.

reliability.rationale: Single conditional UPDATE (status active and end_date >= today) is atomic, so repeated or simultaneous cancels change the row once and later ones get 409; cancelled rows stop blocking because the overlap query filters status=active.

scalability.rationale: Primary-key update; no new queries per row.

compatibility.rationale: Per-row form buttons work without JavaScript; Actions header is visually hidden but available to screen readers.

tradeoffs: The ended-reservation test inserts past rows directly into the test database, because D-04 makes that state unreachable through the UI within one test run.
